### 1 — Scene
A fish-and-vegetable meal: salmon, white beans, roasted cauliflower, avocado, and a leafy salad with small toppings.

### 2 — Vessel
A rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:  
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².**

### 3 — Items
Visible foods appear to be salmon, white beans, cauliflower, mixed salad leaves, avocado, small amounts of crumbled cheese, walnuts and dried cranberries. A light oil/dressing sheen is visible.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Areas are allocated without double-counting overlapping foods. Oil coats other items, so adds no separate footprint.

**Coverage check:** 82% of the plate, consistent with the visible food coverage.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **413 g and 590 kcal** is plausible for this plate. Most weight comes from cauliflower, fish and avocado; the leafy salad and scattered toppings contribute relatively little. Avocado weight excludes skin. Dressing quantity and topping identities are the largest uncertainties.
